feeds.title: 21st Century Burlesque Magazine
feeds.description: In-depth Interviews, news, fashion, reviews, festival diaries, columns, and tutorials. 21st Century Burlesque Magazine is the leading burlesque and variety publication for 13 years. Read the magazine and learn more about burlesque styles, guides, and more. You can also read the interviews and get to know popular opinions.

feeds.title: Daily Burlesque
feeds.description: Information on burlesque performance techniques, business, history, and more! This is Jo Weldon's New-York based blog about Burlesque with original articles, striptease tips, interviews, class announcements, news, photo posts, peeks into performers' closets, and more.

feeds.title: Burlexe
feeds.description: Get everything you need to know about the world of burlesque along with news, events, amazing modern burlesque performers and iconic burlesque legends. Burlexe is an edutainment brand, giving you life through uplifting shows, feelgood tutorials, statement accessories, inspiration from the worlds of burlesque and fascinating stories of performers themselves.

feeds.title: Burlesque with Paris Blog
feeds.description: Catch up with the latest Burlesque with Paris news in Goole, Selby, Doncaster and across the UK. Burlesque isn't just about rhinestones and feathers. From improving posture to bring out that sassy sensual side, Paris Chantilly will lead you on a journey through the art of tease and self-discovery.

feeds.title: Bamboozle Room
feeds.description: Behind the scenes stories from Sydney's dinner show venue. Articles related to life and work in the live performance industry in Australia, especially in the niche of burlesque comedy and cabaret in Sydney. Entertainment tips about live shows and culture and nightlife in Sydney.

feeds.title: Burlesque Moms Blog
feeds.description: Burlesque Moms is a podcast and blog all about burlesque performance and motherhood. We cover topics from sewing tutorials, tape and adhesive reviews, stage etiquette, burlesque as a business, and so much more!
